test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
'A # B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

'A @ B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

'A % B' means 'A is the wife of B'.

If L @ M % F # Q & P @ N, then how is F related to P?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 #
 @
 &
 %
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Daughter
 Husband
 Wife
 
 

 

Given: L @ M % F # Q & P @ N

It means: L is the Daughter of M, M is the Wife of F, F is the Brother of Q, Q is the Husband of P, P is the Daughter of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7d039886019e97191a8470f7f9ed2f145af834db96d8f765431c7ecfa5ef003.png] 

So, F is the **'Husband's brother'** of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
